text:
If you want to support open source, don't feel pressured to write a massive check immediately. Instead, start a small monthly habit: set up a recurring micro-donation of just five or ten dollars to your favorite library or tool. 

Consistency is often more valuable to maintainers than a one-time windfall. It provides a predictable baseline for their budgets and helps build a community of sustainable support. Small, automated contributions turn passive users into active stakeholders.
